title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. INTERVALS. SHORT BURSTS, HONEST RESTS. STAIRS, FLOOR, AND CORE. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. THURSDAY INTERVALS. FIFTEEN MINUTES. SHORT BURSTS, HONEST RESTS. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE STAIRS, THEN HIT THE INTERVALS. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. THURSDAY INTERVALS DONE. HEART HONEST. CORE AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: USE A LOW STAIR. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON THE RAIL IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. DRIVE THROUGH THE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN BURSTS. STEADY BREATH. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL ENGINE. QUALITY BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH. HANDS SET. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL WORK. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A PANICKED SPIDER.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: FIFTH STAIR. HANDS ON THE STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER WITH CONTROL. PRESS UP CLEAN. DO NOT DROP THE STEP.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. HANDS ON THE STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER WITH CONTROL. THIS IS YOUR PRESS INTERVAL. DO NOT CHEAT THE DEPTH, YOU LAZY SOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. FEEL THE BACK LEG AND GLUTE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. FEEL THE GLUTE. THIS IS YOUR LEG INTERVAL. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A WET TENT.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. STACK THE HIPS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. DO NOT CHASE TWENTY.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. STACK THE HIPS. SHORT HOLD. THIS IS YOUR CORE INTERVAL. DO NOT SHAKE LIKE A LEAF IN A GALE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
